entries.title: Cities: Skylines
entries.definitive_edition: Cities: Skylines on Windows PC with DLC and Workshop/mod support

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with Workshop/mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC/mod route
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original and most complete route, with the full DLC library, Steam Workshop/mod support, keyboard-and-mouse controls, and the best capture/settings flexibility. Remastered on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S is a strong console upgrade, but it does not replace the PC mod/DLC ecosystem.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Epic, Microsoft Store, or Paradox and add the DLC packs you want; use Workshop mods if you want the fullest city-builder toolkit.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with full DLC/mod route and high-end capture/settings support.
all_releases.reason: primary: original, most complete, and best-supported route.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Remastered improves the console route, but Windows PC remains the most complete and flexible version because of DLC, mods, and capture/settings support.

entries.remaster_caveats: Cities: Skylines - Remastered is the current-gen console remaster of the first game, not a separate sequel. Cities: Skylines II is a separate entry.

entries.title: Cities: Skylines II
entries.definitive_edition: Cities: Skylines II on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Cities: Skylines II is currently released on Windows PC only, making PC the only playable sourced route. The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions have been repeatedly delayed and are not a released best-version option as of June 23, 2026.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Microsoft Store/Game Pass for PC, or Paradox. Re-check the console recommendation only after Paradox publishes a firm PS5/Xbox Series release.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with the current update path.
all_releases.reason: primary: only released public platform as of June 23, 2026.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no released console version to compare yet; Windows PC is the only playable release route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions remain delayed/unreleased as of June 23, 2026, so they are not listed as release rows yet. Cities: Skylines - Remastered belongs to the first game.
